# Plain Metal's generateMipmapsForTexture: chains measured on an Apple M4 (macOS 27.0.1): every
# level of each chain, two runs and one under MTL_DEBUG_LAYER=1 byte-identical. Seeded random first
# levels of each format the filter computes in a 7x5 2D texture and a 5x4x3 3D texture (and a
# two-slice 7x5 array of RGBA8Unorm), the float and normalized formats' extremes in a 7x5 texture,
# and pairs of values averaged halfway (R32Float and R16Float on and below the least normal,
# RG11B10Float infinities and NaNs).
#
#   chain <format> <2d|3d> <width>x<height>x<depth> <layers>
#   L<level> <the level's bytes, every layer in turn, hex>
